HF024

Attributes in entity 9: WS10 hillslope discharge data

     Details
1. DBCODE
Definition: FSDB Database Code
Domain: enum
2. ENTITY
Definition: Entity Number
Units: number
Domain: range (minimum = 9.  maximum = 9.)
3. SITE
Definition: Site location
Domain: place
4. DATETIME
Definition: Date and time of sample collection
Units: date as datetime type
Domain: range (minimum = Apr 24 2002 1:17PM  maximum = Mar 31 2003 11:39PM)
5. CAPROD_TEMP
Definition: Hillslope water temperature from capacitance rod, does not equal actual water temperature
Units: degrees Celsius
Domain: range (minimum = -4.4  maximum = 31.9)
6. DISCHARGE
Definition: Hillslope water discharge from entity 9
Units: liters per second
Domain: range (minimum = 0.0059  maximum = 1.1936)
7. QCODE
Definition: Data quality codes
Domain: enum
